user.title: API Key
user.description: Request your API key from **ginko.support-ssi@keolis.com** and paste it here.

data_description.api_key: The key will be validated by calling the API before continuing.

mode.title: Monitoring mode
mode.description:
**Stop by name** — shows all departures at a location (all lines and directions combined). A "location" groups several physical stops sharing the same name, e.g. both sides of a road or the bus and tram stops on the same square.

**Stop by line and direction** — targets one specific physical stop: you pick the location name, then the line, then the direction. Useful when you want a sensor dedicated to a single line with its next departure as the state value.

**Line disruptions** — service status and disruption messages for a given line.

**Vehicle positions** — real-time location of buses and trams on a line.

data_description.name: Displayed in the integrations list. Leave empty to use the stop name.

lieu.title: Stop by name
lieu.description: The API performs fuzzy matching: "Victor Hugo", "Chamars", etc.

data_description.nom: Partial names accepted — the API will return departures from the first matching stop.
data_description.nb_passages: Between 1 and 5. Each departure corresponds to an upcoming bus or tram.

liste.title: Stop name
liste.description:
Enter the stop name. The next step will only display the lines serving it.

You can add multiple stop / line / direction combinations in the same sensor.

data_description.nb_passages: Visible only during the first setup — applies to all lines.

data.add_another: Add another combination after this one

person.title: Nearby stops for a person
person.description: Select a **person** entity (e.g. `person.stephane`). The card will display Ginko stops within 500 m of their GPS location, updated in real time.

data_description.person_entity_id: Must be a `person` domain entity with GPS location available.

scan_config.title: Update frequency
scan_config.description: Automatic refresh adapts to the vehicle type: **10 s for trams**, **30 s for buses**.
